source_difference.guide_2022: The guide directs an 18-kΩ pull-up calculator result to the 18K Temperature Model, and a 180-kΩ pull-up result to the 180K Temperature Model.
source_difference.faq_2024_section_5_9: For thermistors other than the FAQ named Semitec defaults, use the calculator and add the generated coefficients to the Custom Temperature Model.
source_difference.trm_rev_b: OPT[5:4] selects pull-up independently from OPT[3:2] polynomial/model selection. 18K and 180K each expose a1-a5, b1-b4, and Adc0; Custom exposes the same nine polynomial fields plus Rc0 and Adc0. The shared a/b fields have matching polynomial element definitions.
source_difference.candidate_resolution: Semitec product data gives 10kΩ±1% and B25/85=3435K±1%; TI FAQ names Semitec 103-AT as basis of 18K default. This supports 18K as model candidate for 103AT-2, not an exact-variant accuracy guarantee. Keep onboard A1 in Custom using its full manufacturer R/T table; obtain TI GPC output, write/readback, then sweep.

delays_hysteresis_recovery.status: trip delays and recovery temperatures are review candidates; recovery-time and total shutdown latency remain for system validation
delays_hysteresis_recovery.basis: Cell high-temperature recovery values are strictly below EVE recommendations (<45 °C charge, <60 °C discharge); low-temperature recovery uses provisional 3 °C hysteresis. Zero delay avoids added AFE timer delay but not sensor response, ADC update, MCU and FET turn-off latency.
delays_hysteresis_recovery.required_error_budget: For each trip direction, guard margin must cover NTC tolerance, curve-fit error, pull-up/AFE/ADC error, mounting gradient, thermal lag, sampling/filtering and charger/load/FET turn-off latency.

cell_temperature_basis.recommended_reference_measurement: K-type thermocouple near cell middle, 30 mm above bottom; measurement-system accuracy within ±2 °C
cell_temperature_basis.measurement_boundary: ±2 °C is the EVE reference measurement recommendation, not proven total error for this BQ+NTC+mounting chain.

protection.current_derating_boundary: EVE INR18650-30P specifies 1.5 A standard and 4.0 A maximum charge current per cell; project TODO notes maximum is defined at 25 °C. 4P x 4.0 A = 16 A with no sharing margin. Temperature thresholds do not authorize 16 A over the full temperature range; charger/current derating strategy must be separately approved.
